title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Grant Handoff Acceptance Capture Persistence Boundary
goal: Plan and validate the approval application authority grant handoff acceptance capture persistence boundary without enabling DB/runtime writes, live acceptance capture, execution, providers, dispatch, mutation, network, or spend.
safetyRules: Do not persist acceptance capture, write DB/runtime records, create DB tables, create migrations, or write local runtime state in P128.1.
Do not capture acceptance, accept handoff, hand off authority, grant authority, activate authority, apply approvals, or record approve/reject decisions.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/logs/policy dumps, raw SQL, raw table names, raw report paths, or raw private IDs in primary UX.
Preserve Chat with NEXUS and Lite cleanliness unless a later scoped UX subphase explicitly allows a change.
reuseCheck: Reuse shared/resultEnvelope.js for later dry-run envelopes.
Reuse shared/redaction.js and shared/modeGuard.js if later runtime-facing metadata needs guardrails.
Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js patterns when status helpers are needed.
Reuse existing dashboard cards/routes/tests; do not duplicate UI components.
Reuse existing evidence/activity/audit/cost terminology; do not create new appenders in P128.1.
commandCenterUx: P128.1 adds no UI. Existing P127.5 scoped read-only capture UX stays on Business Build and Agent Flow only. Chat with NEXUS and Lite stay chat-focused and clean.
costImpact: No provider calls, model calls, network calls, runtime execution, DB writes, deploy/package creation, or provider spend.
